title: Heat, Radiation, and Bulk Matter
question: How do microscopic energy and particle counts become temperature, radiation, and laboratory-scale matter?
summary: Link Boltzmann and Avogadro scaling to ideal gases, molar quantities, black-body radiation, Wien laws, and Stefan-Boltzmann emission. Partition functions and standard-state dependence expose the assumptions and limits behind thermodynamic and bulk-matter relationships.

caveats: A chapter shell defines curriculum scope; it is not an evaluated scientific result.
